name: SEO Workflow Automation
headline: Dammaray: SEO Workflow Automation Tool
short_description: Dammaray is an AI-driven tool designed to automate SEO and GEO workflows, enabling marketers and developers to optimize content for search engines. With features like keyword analysis, content rewriting, and API integrations, it enhances productivity and effectiveness in digital marketing efforts.
author: dammaray

sections.overview:
Dammaray is an open-source AI tool that automates both traditional SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) workflows. It performs keyword research, on-page audits, backlink analysis, and competitor benchmarking while rewriting content for improved clarity and relevance in AI-driven search responses. The tool integrates with Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and OpenAI APIs to deliver real-time data and actionable insights. It supports multiple output formats including Markdown, JSON, and PDF reports, and runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux with both online and offline modes for flexibility and privacy.
Automating keyword research for content creation
Rewriting existing content for SEO optimization
Integrating with APIs for enhanced data analysis
Streamlining GEO-targeted marketing campaigns
sections.usage:
```
Act as an SEO expert using Dammaray. Analyze the following content for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Provide keyword suggestions, content optimization tips, and a revised version of the content with improved SEO. The content is: [CONTENT].
```
Copy

```
# SEO Analysis for [Company Name] in the [Industry] Sector
```
